paragraphs.source_en: I go with the wind, people of Orphalese, but not down into emptiness; And if this day is not a fulfilment of your needs and my love, then let it be a promise till another day.

units.source_en: I go with the wind, people of Orphalese, but not down into emptiness; And if this day is not a fulfilment of your needs and my love, then let it be a promise till another day.

ja.t: りてゆくのではない。もしこの

paragraphs.source_en: Man’s needs change, but not his love, nor his desire that his love should satisfy his needs.

units.source_en: Man’s needs change, but not his love, nor his desire that his love should satisfy his needs.

paragraphs.source_en: The mist that drifts away at dawn, leaving but dew in the fields, shall rise and gather into a cloud and then fall down in rain.

units.source_en: The mist that drifts away at dawn, leaving but dew in the fields, shall rise and gather into a cloud and then fall down in rain.

paragraphs.source_en: In the stillness of the night I have walked in your streets, and my spirit has entered your houses,

units.source_en: In the stillness of the night I have walked in your streets, and my spirit has entered your houses,

paragraphs.source_en: And your heart-beats were in my heart, and your breath was upon my face, and I knew you all.

units.source_en: And your heart-beats were in my heart, and your breath was upon my face, and I knew you all.

ja.t: にかかっていた。そして
はあなたがたすべてを

paragraphs.source_en: Ay, I knew your joy and your pain, and in your sleep your dreams were my dreams.

units.source_en: Ay, I knew your joy and your pain, and in your sleep your dreams were my dreams.

ja.t: っていた。あなたがたが

paragraphs.source_en: I mirrored the summits in you and the bending slopes, and even the passing flocks of your thoughts and your desires.

units.source_en: I mirrored the summits in you and the bending slopes, and even the passing flocks of your thoughts and your desires.

ja.t: した。さらには、あなたがたの

paragraphs.source_en: And to my silence came the laughter of your children in streams, and the longing of your youths in rivers.

units.source_en: And to my silence came the laughter of your children in streams, and the longing of your youths in rivers.

ja.t: のもとへ、あなたがたの

paragraphs.source_en: And when they reached my depth the streams and the rivers ceased not yet to sing.

units.source_en: And when they reached my depth the streams and the rivers ceased not yet to sing.

ja.t: うことをやめなかった。
